top_signals.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank
top_signals.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump open to pardoning Jensen Huang if needed: NY Post
top_signals.summary: Trump said he would be willing to pardon Jensen Huang if needed and argued that the Nvidia CEO should not have to invoke the Fifth Amendment before Congress.

top_signals.title: BC Partners Buys GSE Sport Agency With Golfer DeChambeau on List
top_signals.summary: BC Partners’ credit arm has agreed to buy a majority stake in GSE Worldwide, a sports marketing agency which represents athletes such as golf celebrity Bryson DeChambeau and former NFL and MLB star Bo Jackson.

top_signals.title: How does EIA compare different types of energy?
top_signals.summary: To compare production and consumption across different resources, we convert to a common energy metric, British thermal units (Btu), which typically measures the heat content of the fuels such as petroleum, natural gas, and coal that are burned for energy. For energy sources such as hydropower, wind, solar, and geothermal that aren't combusted to create energy, we apply a constant conversion factor based on the heat content of electricity.
